about.title: About Me
about.description:
I'm a Full Stack Developer with a Master's in Software Architecture. I've worked with every .NET generation — from .NET Framework 2.0, 3.5 and 4.x to .NET Core and .NET 5 through 10 and 11 — and the migrations in between, with Vue, React and Next.js on the frontend.

I care about code that's clear, maintainable and makes sense: Clean Architecture, CQRS and boring, reliable pipelines with Docker, Kubernetes and Azure DevOps.

Lately I build AI tooling too — MCP servers, agent workflows and guardrails that let AI agents do real work safely.
about.shortDescription: Full Stack .NET Developer and Software Architect — from .NET Framework 2.0 to .NET 10/11 — with Vue, React and Next.js on the frontend. I build clear, maintainable software and AI tooling that does real work.

personal.title: RepoRinse
personal.desc: Local, deterministic Rust CLI that keeps repos clean: strips AI co-author trailers, whitespace noise and invisible Unicode, with guardrails for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor.

personal.title: davinci-resolve-mcp
personal.desc: MCP server to edit in DaVinci Resolve by talking to an AI producer: vertical and horizontal cuts, motion, captions, beat-synced music and QA before every render.

personal.title: social-publisher-mcp
personal.desc: An AI community manager for short-form video as an MCP server: writes the copy for every network, schedules posts and reports what worked.

personal.title: declaracion
personal.desc: Personal tax assistant for Mexico inside your AI agent: reads CFDI, computes ISR and IVA (RESICO) and guides the filing. Data stays on your PC.

personal.title: wikdoc
